sections.voiceover: Chasing England's 241 runs, Pakistan sat at 154-9, needing a miracle to avoid certain defeat.
Could Khan's unbeaten 113, the highest score ever by a number 8 batter, change the outcome?
The match seemed lost until this lower-order duo defied England on October 25, 2026.
Their 89-run partnership in 80 balls pushed Pakistan past England's total score of 241 runs. Pakistan won by one wicket, ending a 51-year 10th-wicket record.
An 89-run last-wicket stand rewrote cricket history.
